column3: “People reach boundaries” is rendered “Some remove the landmarks,” and “pastured” as “devour.”
“There!” is rendered “Behold, as.” The verse is difficult, and the meaning is uncertain.
“They go about naked” is rendered “They cause the poor to go about naked,” and “hungry they carry a sheaf” as “they take away the sheaves from the hungry.”
“Between their rows” is rendered “Within the walls”; the meaning is uncertain.
“They pay no regard to its ways” is rendered “They do not want to know its ways.”
“Covering of face he puts” is rendered “he disguises his face.”
“Swift is he” is rendered “They are insignificant”; the verse is difficult, and the meaning is uncertain.
“The womb” is rendered “A mother,” and “sucks on him” as “feeds sweetly.”
NASB capitalizes “He,” taking the subject as God.
“Like everyone they are contracted” is rendered “like everything gathered up,” and “wither” as “are cut off.”
